technical.summary: ABBV shows mixed technicals with bullish trend structure (price above key MAs, supertrend, Ichimoku) but lacks momentum confirmation (weak ADX, non-rising RSI, no OBV support), making this a moderate-quality entry with elevated risk of pullback.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 101 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and non-directional; market fear (36/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and weak insider conviction limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (282.6) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event in 2 days adds near-term volatility; earnings 101 days out provides buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable for risk assets.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with supertrend bullish and Ichimoku cloud support provides structural uptrend confirmation in a fear-driven market offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely unfavourable (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, FOMC volatility in 2 days) combined with zero momentum confirmation (weak ADX, non-rising RSI, no OBV support, overbought stochastic), high earnings risk in 101 days, and zero smart money/insider conviction make this a high-risk entry with poor risk/reward.

decision.entry_rationale: While price structure (above 200-EMA, supertrend bullish, Ichimoku support) shows technical uptrend confirmation in a fear-driven market, the macro environment is severely unfavourable with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels creating unacceptable near-term volatility risk.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event in 2 days combined with VIX at crisis levels (282.6) and zero momentum confirmation (weak ADX, non-rising RSI, overbought stochastic without OBV support) creates high probability of sharp pullback before structural uptrend can develop.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on unfavourable macro environment and weak momentum confirmation despite bullish structure
